body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Enspert(www.enspert.com) introduced next-generation Android Tablet PC 'E301' with full metal body for the first time at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

E301, the next model of Tablet PC 'E201' which has been released already in Korea and overseas, is loaded Android 2.2(Froyo). It features 7-inch display with upgraded resolution of 1024x600 and full-metal body.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
